changelog: FIX (critical): Continue Watching for a series no longer opens the wrong content. The click handler was sending series_id values to the VOD/movie detail screen, which then resolved them to whatever movie happened to share that numeric id (in a paying user's report, that surfaced an adult-content title). Now dispatches by content kind — series → series detail, movie → movie detail.

REMOVED: All HushXXX subsystem code (HushXxxApi, HushXxxAgeGate, HushXxxScreen, HushXxxDmcaDialog, Hush+ HushXXX teaser tile, mobile + TV navigation route stubs). The standalone adult library was retired in v1.43.99; this build deletes the dead code entirely.

FIX: One-shot defensive purge of any stale legacy adult-content entries in your Continue Watching list — anything pointing at the old HushXXX backend or matching a known adult-title pattern is tombstoned and propagates the deletion to every other device on the same profile via sync.
INHERITED v1.44.132: Lite-mode boot refresh, main-looper resilience handler, tightened Coil mem cache, bundle-index prewarm.
